name: status
description: Return the raw account status API response without summarizing, redacting body fields, or adding calculated fields.

name: scrapeHtml
description: Retrieve the raw HTML of a page. Browser rendering is optional.

arguments.name: url
arguments.desc: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL of the page to process.

arguments.name: blockResources
arguments.desc: Whether to block images, fonts, and stylesheets while loading the page.

arguments.name: browserRendering
arguments.desc: Whether to render the page in a browser before returning the result.

arguments.name: geoCode
arguments.desc: Two-letter country code to load the page from, sent in lowercase.

arguments.name: maxRetries
arguments.desc: Maximum number of retries, as a nonnegative integer. Omit this parameter for no limit.

arguments.name: proxy
arguments.desc: Custom proxy URL used to load the page.

arguments.name: proxyCountry
arguments.desc: Two-letter country code of the proxy server, sent in lowercase.

arguments.name: returnCookie
arguments.desc: Whether to include browser session cookies in the response.

arguments.name: saveResult
arguments.desc: Whether to save the result to the dashboard Result tab.

arguments.name: super
arguments.desc: Whether to route the request through real devices.

arguments.name: timeout
arguments.desc: Page load timeout in seconds, from 1 to 300. The HTTP request allows 30 additional seconds.

arguments.name: waitForSelector
arguments.desc: Wait for the page to contain the specified CSS selector before returning the result.

arguments.name: waitUntil
arguments.desc: Navigation completion event to wait for: domcontentloaded, load, networkidle0, or networkidle2.

arguments.name: warmStart
arguments.desc: Whether to enable warm start for more reliable scraping, at the cost of additional latency.

name: webSearch
description: Search the web and return ranked results with titles, URLs, descriptions, and sources.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Search query text, trimmed before sending, containing 1 to 1000 characters.

arguments.name: country
arguments.desc: Two-letter country code to search from, sent in lowercase.

arguments.name: numResults
arguments.desc: Number of search results to request, as an integer from 10 to 100. Fewer results may be returned.
